graph_effect.label: No road-pricing findings in the graph. Literature range for NO2: Stockholm -5% to -15% ambient (Simeonova et al. 2021)

prediction_scored: partial. The primary NO2 test could not be run: the EPA AQS daily NO2 files for 2022-2025 contain no monitor in Manhattan (sites: IS 52 and Pfizer Lab in the Bronx, Queens College 2 and Queens College Near Road). The secondary PM2.5 estimate, -5.2% (-9.5 to -0.9), falls in the registered range (0% to -8%), but it rests on one monitor that samples one day in three and is not robust: on the same days, against the two comparison monitors that ran in every year (IS 52, Queens College 2), PS 19's excess changed by -0.3%. The 2024 placebo is -2.0% (-8.2 to +4.2).
settle: An in-zone NO2 record with a pre-period. Candidates: the NYCCAS street-level two-week samples at in-zone sites (not published as a time series), the DEC Division Street site (PM2.5 began 2025; no pre-period), satellite NO2 (TROPOMI, about 5 km pixels, too coarse for a 23 km2 zone but usable for a Manhattan vs outer-borough contrast) and the low-cost sensor networks used by Fraser et al.

research_needed.question: Publish the NYCCAS biweekly site-level measurements inside the CRZ for 2022-2025.
Reconcile Fraser et al. (2025) with the DOHMH 2026 report: daily maximum vs daily mean, monitor sets, counterfactual model.
research_needed.data: both studies' monitor lists and code

notes: Against Manhattan monitors north of 60th Street the PM2.5 estimate is -3.9% (-11.4 to +5.0). Restricting to sites observed before and after gives -5.3% (-9.8 to -0.9). The two-way fixed-effects estimate depends on which comparison monitors enter, because three Brooklyn and Bronx monitors started in mid-2023 and two more in 2025. The research on this exact question disagrees. Fraser et al. (2025, npj Clean Air) report daily maximum PM2.5 in the zone 22% below a counterfactual in January-June 2025; the NYC Health Department (August 2026) reports no significant difference for PM2.5, NO2, NO or black carbon in 2025. The NO2 test was re-registered as mob-crz-air-nyccas.
